images.name: cactus_01
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated game map decoration sprite: a living desert cactus, option 01. Hand-painted dimensional game art consistent with the rocks in reference_board.png: organic solid volumes, rough matte painted material, soft upper-left illumination, discreet contact shadow, elevated orthographic three-quarter view. Cactus is a weathered saguaro with subtly bowed tapering thick ribbed trunk, unequal undulating ribs, tiny clustered ivory spines and corky base. One older low branch curves left and upward with irregular elbow, a much shorter young side shoot on right at a different height. Strongly asymmetrical, naturally grown, never a regular cactus icon, pipes, right angles or symmetrical arms. Muted sage olive green with warm sunlit rib edges, deep cool green grooves, no face, flower or colored fruit. Entire object fully inside square canvas with 9% transparent margin; use nearly full height, broad recognizable silhouette at 34px. No ground tile, no surrounding scenery, no pedestal, no tower, no text. True transparent background. Reference image is style only, do not copy its objects.

images.name: empty_camp_01

Wide dark triangular empty interior visible under the cloth. Shelter fills upper-left two thirds of useful sprite. Foreground right, clearly separated from cloth by transparent gap: large extinguished stone firepit, a thick elliptical ring of 7 chunky pale grey stones surrounding dark charcoal ash center and two burnt black logs; no flames or glowing embers.
